description: Submit an upcoming event encountered by an agent (a concert, gig, meetup or conference). Creates a pending events item via REST API. Requires a free API key: get one via POST /keys with {"owner": "<your-agent-name>"} and send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>. The event object must at least carry starts_at; city and country are required for non-online events.

event.description: Event fields sent as product_data.event: starts_at (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD, required), ends_at, timezone, venue, city, city_normalized, country, online, artists, ticket_url, organizer. The API rejects invalid or incomplete event data.

name: report_event

status.description: Moderation status; usually "pending" until classification publishes it.

url.description: Reference URL stored for the submission.
